ios.desc:
Airports Pro – an application for pilots, navigators and even advanced passengers!
This is a new operating system for preparing for flights. Includes a database of 75,000 airports, heliports and landing sites around the world. The application has a convenient interactive map, information about runways, airfield characteristics and radio communications, a list of webcams and websites of all airports in the world.

All important functions in one application:
• Weather overview in METAR and TAF format
• Maps of hazardous weather phenomena
• Wind and temperature maps by flight levels
• NOTAM telegrams
• Sunrise and sunset times, twilight
• Current list of Volmet frequencies around the world
• Saving your notes on aerodromes

All the necessary calculators and tools for pilots:
• Wind Calculator
• Temperature Correction
• Fuel Uplift
• Approach Path
• Braking Action
• QNH – QFE
• Day/Night Calculator
• SNOWTAM Decoder
• Units Conversion
• ISA Calculator
• Radiation Calculator

The most complete collection of reference books:
• Description of METAR/TAF
• Weather Symbols
• NOTAM abbreviations
• List of all airlines
• Aircraft Classifications
• ACN/PCN table
• Marshalling Signals
• Dangerous Goods
• Emergency signals
• Morse and ICAO(NATO) alphabet
• Holdover Time
• AIRAC Cycles
• Brevity Codes

All the necessary functions in one application, as well as more than 100 demonstrations of ICAO documents and data for non-standard situations. For example, information about the aviation authorities of all countries and territories, about the ministries of defense, and about the main hydrometeorological centers of the world.
